0.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPBRONZELAKE_00114_RUKUSAFARUSA_000_000
0.description: Hello, and welcome to Bronze Lake. May I be of assistance?
0.translation_description: Salve e benvenuto al Lago di Bronzo. Posso esserti d'aiuto?

1.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPBRONZELAKE_00114_RUKUSAFARUSA_000_010
1.description: I am tasked with caring for the sick and wounded soldiers who visit our hot springs.
1.translation_description: Mi occupo dei soldati malati e feriti che vengono alle nostre terme.

2.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPBRONZELAKE_00114_RUKUSAFARUSA_000_011
2.description: One must keep a close eye on those suffering from injuries, as they tend to linger in the waters overlong. Though the springs are famous for their healing qualities, extended bouts of bathing can end up doing more harm than good.
2.translation_description: Bisogna tenere d'occhio i feriti, perché tendono a restare nelle acque troppo a lungo. Le sorgenti sono famose per le loro proprietà curative, ma immergersi per troppo tempo può fare più male che bene.

3.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPBRONZELAKE_00114_RUKUSAFARUSA_000_012
3.description: Aside from convalescing troops, we also have the occasional visit from somewhat more...eccentric patrons.
3.translation_description: Oltre ai soldati in convalescenza, ogni tanto riceviamo visite da avventori un po'... eccentrici.

4.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPBRONZELAKE_00114_RUKUSAFARUSA_000_020
4.description: The hot springs of Bronze Lake were built on the ruins of the civilization of Nym.
4.translation_description: Le terme del Lago di Bronzo furono costruite sulle rovine della civiltà di Nym.

5.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPBRONZELAKE_00114_RUKUSAFARUSA_000_021
5.description: This building itself is called the Warmwine Sanitorium. The name comes from the practice of heating bottles of spiced wine in the waters, which imbues the liquor with potent curative properties.
5.translation_description: Questo edificio si chiama Sanatorio Vinocaldo. Il nome deriva dall'usanza di scaldare nelle acque bottiglie di vino speziato, che così acquisisce potenti proprietà curative.

6.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPBRONZELAKE_00114_RUKUSAFARUSA_000_022
6.description: We have treated soldiers here since the Battle of Carteneau. And considering that skirmishes with imperial and beastman forces continue unabated, I expect the springs will remain busy for the foreseeable future.
6.translation_description: Qui curiamo i soldati fin dalla Battaglia di Carteneau. E, visto che gli scontri con le forze imperiali e gli uomini bestia continuano senza sosta, prevedo che le terme resteranno affollate ancora a lungo.

9.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPBRONZELAKE_00114_A1_000_002
9.description: What kind of place is this?
